overall_summary: The sample size is extremely small across all initial uploads, resulting in negligible view counts and zero engagement. No definitive winning patterns can be extracted yet, so the strategy must rely on controlled exploration with a focus on high-retention storytelling structures.

winning_patterns.evidence: All recent videos have views under 20 with zero engagement.
winning_patterns.action: Shift focus to strengthening the hook-to-retention pipeline.

weak_patterns.evidence: Multiple videos used variations of phone numbers and night-time settings ('नंबर ब्लॉक नहीं किया', 'नंबर पर अभी भी', 'रात के दो बजे'), which yielded low performance.
weak_patterns.action: Explore fresh, everyday physical triggers instead of digital/phone clichés.
